name: Word count
description: A made-up vault plugin with no code in the app: commands that count the words of the vault's notes, keep a list of notes changed, and say when they started.
author: Bob Lee

ops.summary: Count the words of the Markdown files in a folder.
ops.help:
Reads the files where they are (the vault's folder) and answers {folder, files, words}.

  vau words Notes

folder.description: a folder of the vault (the whole vault when left out)

ops.summary: The notes changed since the server started, as this plugin's event hook noted them.
